entries.definition: To "catch strays" is to get criticized or mocked in passing when the argument was about someone else; chat used it for people pulled into this week's orbiter drama.
Reference to the Dark Triad psychological theory; used for accusations of those traits or mental illness generally.
Used in chat's argument over who was and wasn't invited to an in-person meetup of streamers from Destiny's orbit in early November 2026.
Streamers in Destiny's social circle who appear on his stream and in DGG. Chat often discusses their rivalries and whether they should get space in DGG.
A streamer in Destiny's social circle who appears on his stream and in DGG; "orbiter drama" is chat's name for conflicts among them.
Members of snark communities; used by h3 fans and Destiny regulars (32.0) as an insult; snark also self-applies
Used in chat's recap of a dispute over changed plans during a group trip by streamers in Destiny's orbit.
Someone who obsessively mocks or hate-watches a streamer, from "snark" communities; in DGG it's an insult for a person seen as doing that, including other streamers.
Attention and status online; "clout chaser" or "clout shark" is an accusation that someone acts mainly to gain it.
Chat's catch-all for the current conflict among streamers in Destiny's orbit; it spikes whenever a new round breaks.
DGG's feature for embedding a stream in the chat page. "Embed wars" is chat's term for orbiter streamers competing to be watched there.
Mocking, gossipy criticism of a streamer; also used as a verb ("to snark"). DGG chat uses it both for outside snark communities and for its own dunking.
